image.name: emby
image.description: [Emby](https://emby.media/) organizes video, music, live TV, and photos from personal media libraries and streams them to smart TVs, streaming boxes and mobile devices. This container is packaged as a standalone emby Media Server.

changelog.desc: Update lib paths to fix hw transcoding.
Rebase to Ubuntu Resolute.
Set home to /config.
Rebase to Ubuntu Noble.
Use universal hardware acceleration blurb
Fix tonemapping so it's done with hw acceleration.
Deprecate armhf. As announced [here](https://www.linuxserver.io/blog/a-farewell-to-arm-hf)
Fix package extraction so it doesn't change /tmp perms.
Use upstream deb packages instead of rpm.
Update chown behavior.
Migrate to s6v3, rebase to Ubuntu Jammy.
Structural changes upstream.
Deprecate `UMASK_SET` in favor of UMASK in baseimage, see above for more information. Remove no longer used mapping for /transcode.
Rebase to Focal, see [here](https://docs.linuxserver.io/faq#my-host-is-incompatible-with-images-based-on-ubuntu-focal) for troubleshooting armhf.
Fix issue with missing samba folder.
Fix issue with samba and ffmpeg.
Add support for amd vaapi hw transcode.
Add v4l2 support on Raspberry Pi.
Add openmax support on Raspberry Pi.
Allow restarting emby from the gui (also allows for auto restarts after addon updates).
Improve permission fixing for render and dvb devices.
Add umask environment variable.
Fix typos in readme.
Initial release.

image.title: Emby
image.setup_instructions:
Webui can be found at `http://<your-ip>:8096`

Emby has very complete and verbose documentation located [here](https://github.com/MediaBrowser/Wiki/wiki) .

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  emby:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/emby:latest
    container_name: emby
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
    volumes:
      - /path/to/emby/library:/config
      - /path/to/tvshows:/data/tvshows
      - /path/to/movies:/data/movies
      - /opt/vc/lib:/opt/vc/lib #optional
    ports:
      - 8096:8096
      - 8920:8920 #optional
    devices:
      - /dev/dri:/dev/dri #optional
      - /dev/video10:/dev/video10 #optional
      - /dev/video11:/dev/video11 #optional
      - /dev/video12:/dev/video12 #optional
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=emby \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -p 8096:8096 \
  -p 8920:8920 `#optional` \
  -v /path/to/emby/library:/config \
  -v /path/to/tvshows:/data/tvshows \
  -v /path/to/movies:/data/movies \
  -v /opt/vc/lib:/opt/vc/lib `#optional` \
  --device /dev/dri:/dev/dri `#optional` \
  --device /dev/video10:/dev/video10 `#optional` \
  --device /dev/video11:/dev/video11 `#optional` \
  --device /dev/video12:/dev/video12 `#optional` \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/emby:latest
